description:
Found by the fz-da session (blocks fz-3sy.8, and through fz-3ul.4 the distiller's fz-sc8.3); mechanism confirmed by a spike in this session (scratch pd/ in the fz-xxd13-build session, on fz-3ul.4/defexception 582cd31fa; pull.rs, product_drive.rs and reach.rs are identical on develop).

Symptom: a lazily pulled lib module whose top level calls a Kernel macro with a RECURSIVE private helper fails with error[resolve/unknown-module]: module X is not defined. fz-da's case: defexception in lib/exceptions/key_error.fz, reached from Map.fetch!. Minimal repro without defexception: pd/min-repro.patch + pd/probe.fz (lib/probe.fz calls macro probe_define, whose helper probe_flag? recurses; Map.key_error calls Probe.make).

Mechanism (each step observed with prints, pd/debug-prints.patch):
1. The request queue serves Reach(Static(Map.fetch!/2)); the Program scope goes active (Root 0 already active) and its fact-wait pump waits on a StaticCallees fact on the Map.key_error path.
2. The pump's agenda runs dry; its drain serves ANY queued request (drain -> serve_requests -> drive_product_requests), here RootBackendProduct of the macro root, nested under the active Program scope.
3. In that nested root drive, DeriveRecursive(helper) waits on Reach(Static(helper)), a Program-scoped product. next_request (pull.rs ~1727) pops it, sees Program active, parks it.
4. The nested drain finds nothing to serve and calls settle_quiescent_waits (drive.rs ~1233); the wait on the module settles as unknown-module; the pump reaches no_ready_producer (product_drive.rs ~880). The parked request is released only at restore(Program), after the error.

Missing rule: sessions allow one drive per session (ProductSessions::take asserts it; the telemetry validator rejects a session started twice), and parking applies that to the request queue. Every root can need Program-scoped products, so a root drive started beneath an active Program scope can wait on something only the frame beneath it can free. fact-engine.md says a drain serves queued requests before arbitrating quiescence; a parked request is neither served nor counted, so the drain settles anyway. No doc states the parking rule. Parking itself is routine (fixture 00276 parks under the same shape and finishes).

Spiked candidates (lib suite / request count on a small program, baseline 2232 passed / 654):
- E8, a queue-served Program drive with a dry agenda yields when a Root request is pending and is re-queued after the serve loop empties: repro fixed, lib 2232/0, fixture_matrix 3197/0 on the unmodified branch, 654. Caveats: signalled through the fact_wait_budget_exceeded hook plus a flag (scratch hack); the synchronous Program drive from a root's product stack (drive_retained_product ~636) still pumps with Program active; no count of how often it yields; no ping-pong proof.
- Re-entrant serve without parking (E1), releasing the scope around drain (E4): break one-drive-per-session (session started twice), work pins rise.
- Every queue-served drive yields and is woken by fact movement (E3, E6): repro fixed but work rises (697 / 685 requests; reach work pin 431 vs 200).
- Owner pump serves parked requests in its own stack (E7): no-ready-producer on ordinary programs; abandoned, not diagnosed.

Not built. Needs a proposal page: the rule in the title must hold on both the queue-served and the synchronous path, with a real outcome variant, before it is a design.

comments.text: Second program of the class, from fz-da, NOT fixed by the round-1 E8 patch (peer scratch s8/stall2.fz, 11 lines, on fz-da's wip tree where raise is a macro): module T with def go(a), do: raise(KeyError, key: a); main calls T.go(1) inside try/rescue. Fails with resolve/unknown-import: module T does not export go/1. Compiles without the try/rescue, with raise/1, or with panic(KeyError.exception(key: a)) written out. Last events: reach(static, 178) requested and waiting, ExpandFunctionSource(178) runs, then the diagnostic: an interface wait settles as unknown while that expansion's products are pending. Does not occur on 582cd31fa. Given to the round-2 spike.

title: The Program scope is never held across a root drive
